title: Five-element LC low-pass ladder
goal: A reader must be able to trace a 50 Ω source through a five-element LC ladder to a 50 Ω load.

rubric.must: Exactly three labelled inductors are in series along the source-to-load path and exactly two capacitors are shunted from intermediate nodes to ground.
The visible signal path is RSOURCE, L1, C1 shunt node, L2, C2 shunt node, L3, then VOUT.
C1 and C2 each terminate at the ground rail and neither shorts across a series inductor.
A 50 Ω source resistance appears before L1 and a 50 Ω load resistance appears from VOUT to ground.
L1 and L3 read 3.3 µH, L2 reads 4.7 µH, and both capacitors read 1 nF, C0G.
The final node is clearly labelled VOUT.
